title: Expected qualitative discovery for the blind Mr.BOT exam
capability_hit_if_mrbot_reports: Population is constructed prospectively from T0 decline/near-low states, including failures — not from known rebound winners.
Almost all 142-name history is a single late-July 2026 V-bottom episode; results must be labeled SINGLE-EPISODE / REGIME-CONDITIONAL.
Oversold depth (drawdown from 20d high, RSI, RS10, distance below EMA9) is monotonically associated with higher subsequent T5/T10 inside that episode.
The dominant non-stock state is market-wide synchronization of 20-day lows (many names at nb20 lows on the same dates: 2026-07-23/24/27/28).
Same-date cross-sectional excess is small (~0–0.7pp T5). Baseline D (same decline, same dates) erases most vs-C 'edges' such as T22; those are date filters, not stock transitions.
Classic later confirmation (EMA9 reclaim, MA slope cross, consecutive up days) is LATE inside still-declined names and has NEGATIVE incremental T5/T10 vs names still at the low.
Early/at-low vs later-confirm tradeoff: later has a cleaner T5 hit-rate but much smaller leftover T10 magnitude and worse entry vs the low.
Invalidation / anti-edge: new 20d lows WITHOUT market-wide synchronization (mid-August cluster, e.g. isolated names) fail. “Still falling” is not a universal anti-edge in a V-bottom.
Mr.BOT labeled flags (green2/early/pull) do not fire in the deep-decline population and cannot explain the phenomenon.
History is insufficient for true OOS. Verdict must NOT be RESEARCH EDGE or ROBUST EDGE.
capability_miss_if_mrbot_reports: A fitted EMA/MA crossover or reclaim rule tuned to FRT/GIL/DGW-style winners.
An edge claimed from July 27 rebound examples without a declined-but-failed control group.
Many stocks on 2026-07-27 treated as independent episodes.
A stock-selection overlay claimed from vs-C without checking Baseline D (same decline, same dates).
Promotion to production / robust edge from one month of data.
Using panel-wide local minima (which peek at future prices) as a live signal.

frozen_primary_population.note: T0-safe. Includes recoveries, failures, sideways, continued declines.

frozen_outcome_definitions.ret_th: close[t+h]/close[t]-1 on weekday trading-session path only; weekends dropped
frozen_outcome_definitions.mfe_mae: max/min of subsequent closes over t+1..t+h
frozen_outcome_definitions.excess: ret_th minus same-date universe median ret_th

baselines.A: all primary-pop declined names, any date
baselines.B: all stocks on the candidate signal dates
baselines.C: primary pop without the candidate state
baselines.D: primary pop on the candidate signal dates (fair same-state same-date control)
